title: Business Central 2025 wave 1 (BC26.1): New method to add SecretText values to JSON objects – WriteWithSecretsTo
summary: In Business Central 2025 wave 1 (BC26.1), the JsonObject type gets a new method, WriteWithSecretsTo. It takes a dictionary that maps JSONPath placeholder paths to SecretText values, puts each secret in place of its placeholder, and writes the serialized JSON to a SecretText result. The method needs runtime 15.1 or later.
key_points: WriteWithSecretsTo is a new method on the JsonObject type that adds SecretText values to JSON objects
Developers create a JSON object with placeholders, define paths in JSONPath format, and use the method to produce a SecretText with credentials replaced
The feature integrates with the SecretText type introduced in BC23 to protect sensitive values from exposure
Method requires runtime version 15.1 or greater; not available in 15.0

quotes.text: A new method was added to the JsonObject type, which allows developers to add SecretText values.
quotes.why_it_matters: Introduces the core capability for securely embedding secrets in JSON structures
